info.name: SKYGRID Payment Contact Routes
info.description: Proof collection for SKYGRID support and payment-contact routing. These routes expose contact/checkout destinations; they do not prove that a payment executed.

exec: pm.test('Messenger route is configured or fails closed', () => pm.expect([200,503]).to.include(pm.response.code));
pm.test('Messenger route never claims payment execution', () => pm.expect(j.payment_execution).to.eql(false));
if (pm.response.code === 200) { pm.test('Messenger route is payment contact only', () => pm.expect(j.purpose).to.eql('payment_contact')); }
if (pm.response.code === 503) { pm.test('Unconfigured Messenger route fails closed', () => pm.expect(j.error).to.eql('messenger_route_unconfigured')); }
